استجيبا (form X)
# اُسْتُجِيبَا (ustujībā) /us.tu.d͡ʒiː.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَجَابَ (istajāba)
# اِسْتَجِيبَا (istajībā) /is.ta.d͡ʒiː.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَجَابَ (istajāba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
